import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int[][][][] dist = new int[15][15][15][15];
    static int[][] flow = new int[400][400];
    static char[][] scienceLab = new char[20][20];
    static char[][] reactions = new char[20][20];
    static int[] dRow = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dCol = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static int iter = 3;
    static int[] visited = new int[400];
    
    static int rows, T;
    
    static int augment(int node, int dest, int bottleneck) {
        if (node == dest) return bottleneck;
        if (visited[node] == iter) return 0;
        visited[node] = iter;
        for (int nextNode = 0; nextNode <= dest; ++nextNode) {
            if (flow[node][nextNode] > 0) {
                int pushed = augment(nextNode, dest, Math.min(bottleneck, flow[node][nextNode]));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    flow[node][nextNode] -= pushed;
                    flow[nextNode][node] += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int toID(int r, int c) {
        return (r - 1) * rows + (c - 1);
    }
    
    static int[][] reach = new int[13][13];
    static int[][] tmpReach = new int[13][13];
    
    static void expand(int val) {
        for (int r = 0; r < 13; ++r) {
            System.arraycopy(reach[r], 0, tmpReach[r], 0, 13);
        }
        for (int r = 1; r <= rows; ++r) {
            for (int c = 1; c <= rows; ++c) {
                if (tmpReach[r][c] == val) {
                    for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {
                        int nr = r + dRow[dir];
                        int nc = c + dCol[dir];
                        if (nr >= 1 && nc >= 1 && nr <= rows && nc <= rows && reach[nr][nc] < val && scienceLab[nr][nc] != 'Y') {
                            reach[nr][nc] = val;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean reachable(int sr, int sc, int tr, int tc, int infx, int infy) {
        for (int r = 0; r < 13; ++r) {
            Arrays.fill(reach[r], 0);
        }
        reach[sr][sc] = 1;
        reach[infx][infy] = 2;
        for (int iter2 = 0; iter2 < 100; ++iter2) {
            expand(1);
            if (reach[tr][tc] == 1) return true;
            expand(2);
            if (reach[tr][tc] == 2) return false;
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int infx = -1, infy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; ++j) {
                for (int k = 0; k < 15; ++k) {
                    Arrays.fill(dist[i][j][k], 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        rows = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= rows; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            scienceLab[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
            for (int j = 1; j <= rows; ++j) {
                dist[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                if (scienceLab[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    infx = i;
                    infy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= rows; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            reactions[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= rows; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= rows; ++j) {
                for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; ++dir) {
                    int ni = i + dRow[dir];
                    int nj = j + dCol[dir];
                    if (ni >= 1 && nj >= 1 && ni <= rows && nj <= rows) {
                        if (scienceLab[i][j] != 'Y' && scienceLab[ni][nj] != 'Y') {
                            dist[i][j][ni][nj] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int k = 1; k <= rows; ++k) {
            for (int l = 1; l <= rows; ++l) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= rows; ++i) {
                    for (int j = 1; j <= rows; ++j) {
                        for (int m = 1; m <= rows; ++m) {
                            for (int n = 1; n <= rows; ++n) {
                                if (dist[i][j][k][l] < 1000000 && dist[k][l][m][n] < 1000000) {
                                    dist[i][j][m][n] = Math.min(dist[i][j][m][n], dist[i][j][k][l] + dist[k][l][m][n]);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int source = rows * rows * 2 + 1;
        int sink = rows * rows * 2 + 2;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= rows; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= rows; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(scienceLab[i][j])) {
                    flow[source][toID(i, j)] = scienceLab[i][j] - '0';
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(reactions[i][j])) {
                    flow[rows * rows + toID(i, j)][sink] = reactions[i][j] - '0';
                }
                
                if (Character.isDigit(scienceLab[i][j])) {
                    for (int u = 1; u <= rows; ++u) {
                        for (int v = 1; v <= rows; ++v) {
                            if (scienceLab[i][j] > '0' && reactions[u][v] > '0') {
                                if (Character.isDigit(reactions[u][v]) && dist[i][j][u][v] <= T && reachable(i, j, u, v, infx, infy)) {
                                    flow[toID(i, j)][rows * rows + toID(u, v)] = 1000;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int maxFlow = 0;
        int pushed;
        while ((pushed = augment(source, sink, 1000)) > 0) {
            maxFlow += pushed;
            ++iter;
        }
        
        System.out.println(maxFlow);
    }
}
